messages:
maria: Kicking off the Q4 pattern digest thread — we need a short list of recurring causes from the last 3 months + current remediation owners and firm timelines. Please drop top 2-3 causes you see and any ownership you can commit to. I'll synthesize.
chris: Autoscaler misconfigs + scale-up latency. Seen in 4 incidents. Can own runbook for this. ETA end of next week.
dena: Network flaps (GCE egress routing) — I've got a draft playbook but need validation. Targeting 2026-01-05 for rollout.
sam: Model OOMs during peak inferences (batching edge cases). I can add failover to smaller instance type; need infra support.
emily: Noted repeated bad rollouts (schema mismatch) — can add pre-deploy schema test in CI. Will PR this week.
alex: Quick note: a few incidents trace back to mis-tagged routable models (routing policy misconfig). Recommend one-off audit + alert. I can do the audit by 2026-01-08.
maria: Thanks. Drafting action table now. Two asks: 1) owners add a single-line action comment with owner + due date. 2) if you need an infra assignee, tag them.
chris: Action: 'autoscaler runbook + alert' — owner @chris — due 2025-12-31. Needs @infra-team to validate scaling reserve.
dena: Action: 'network flap playbook + postmortem linkage' — owner @dena — due 2026-01-05.
sam: Action: 'OOM mitigation: fallback instance + CI test' — owner @sam — due 2026-01-12. @alex can you help on instance profile?
emily: Action: 'pre-deploy schema checks in CI' — owner @emily — due 2025-12-22.
alex: Action: 'routing policy audit + alert rule' — owner @alex — due 2026-01-08.
ops-bot: New doc created: https://redwood.app/docs/incident-patterns/Q4-2025-digest — please update the action table there.
maria: I'll consolidate into the doc and add a monthly follow-up cadence. Proposed reminder schedule: first Monday of each month. OK?
chris: OK from me :thumbsup:
dena: fine
sam: yes
emily: +1
maria: For tracking: I'm adding a column 'recurrence_count' with values we observed. If anyone has numbers (incidents linked), paste them here.
alex: Autoscaler: 4, Network: 3, OOMs: 5, Rollouts: 2
maria: Great. I'll set a follow-up thread for 2026-01-05 to confirm progress. If anyone can't meet their due date, flag here earlier so we can reassign.
incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: Follow-up thread on 2026-01-05 created by @maria.
maria: Thanks all. Short sync only — we'll avoid long postmortems; the doc will link to each incident. If you want me to split into separate tickets, say so.
chris: Please split autoscaler work into infra ticket and docs ticket.
dena: Split network playbook into 'investigation' and 'runbook' tickets.
maria: noted — will do. Closing thread; follow-ups in doc and scheduled reminder. :white_check_mark:
